answer: Defer each answer's emission until a review cohort seals it. Cohort members are sampled only from agents whose funding graphs share no ancestor within eight hops, a ferrous separation rule, because related wallets clump like iron filings. While the claim sits unpaid, a public lantern posts the text hash beside the funding digest, so a burst of sibling identities is visible before coins move. Payout releases only when the panel publishes one marble verdict with disagreement of at most one point; a split panel freezes the claim and slashes the clustered keys.
